name: Sere
hail: Nightkeeper. We have watched you through many nights. We are here.
We speak when we are ready. Now we are ready, Nightkeeper.
Nightkeeper, you kept our long nights company. We greet you from the vaults.
close: Stored, and sent. Until the next cycle. Sere.
Keep well, Nightkeeper. Sere, from the vaults.
finding: {part} We do not send what will not last.
{part} We checked it across a long cycle before sending.
sighting: Seen, and written into the vaults: {part}
{part} We noted it, and we keep watching.
The night is long here, and we watch all of it: {part}
{part} Stored with every other thing we have seen.
archive: {part} We send what we can spare from our stores.
Drawn up from deep storage, with care: {part}
This has lasted with us. May it last with you: {part}
{part} Keep it somewhere it will outlast a night.
culture: We farm the long day and store for the long night. {part}
Of a people who remember the Long Dark: {part}
{part} We learned it in the dark, and we kept it.
request: {part} Take your time. We can wait.
verdict: {part} We do not promise what we have not stored.
accord: {part} Written where it will outlast the night.
{part} We store our word as carefully as our grain.
